description: A Java class named GetOpt for parsing command line arguments, supporting both legacy (-x) and modern (--argument) styles. Implements methods for argument parsing, usage printing, and handling different option types.

classes.name: GetOpt
classes.description: A utility class for parsing command line options supporting legacy and modern styles, with methods for argument extraction and usage display.

methods.name: getopts
methods.description: Static method to parse both legacy (-x) and modern (--arg) command-line arguments based on provided option definitions.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Displays usage information based on option definitions.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Returns the character representing the legacy option.

methods.name: getOptionString
methods.description: Returns the string representing the modern option.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the option.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets a description for the option.

methods.name: isRemain
methods.description: Checks if this option collects remaining positional arguments.

methods.name: setRemain
methods.description: Sets whether this option captures remaining arguments.

methods.name: isLegacy
methods.description: Indicates if this is a legacy style option (single character).

methods.name: isModern
methods.description: Indicates if this is a modern style option (string).

methods.name: isHelpOption
methods.description: Determines if this option is a help command ('h' or '?').

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Checks if the option is marked as hidden from usage display.

methods.name: setHidden
methods.description: Marks the option as hidden from usage display.

methods.name: hasArguments
methods.description: Checks if the option has associated arguments.

methods.name: getArgument
methods.description: Returns the concatenated arguments as a string.

methods.name: getArgumentList
methods.description: Returns the list of argument tokens.
